meta.name: improve-codebase-architecture
meta.description: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码库发现架构改进点，生成可视化报告并逐项审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望系统化发现并改进代码库的架构问题
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to systematically find and fix architecture issues in your codebase

howto.what: 它会扫描你的项目代码，找出结构上容易别扭、以后难改动的模块，并给出把它们改得更清晰的重构点子。接着生成一份带前后对比图的网页报告，等你挑一个点子后，再和你一步一步讨论怎么实施。
howto.when: 当你要求分析项目代码架构、找出可以改进（深化）的地方，或指定某个模块/子系统/痛点想重点检查时触发。若没指定，它会先看提交历史找热点。

say.text: 帮我扫描一下这个项目的架构，看看哪里值得深化？
say.note: 它会生成一份 HTML 报告。

say.text: 重点看看用户模块，有没有太浅、值得重构的地方？
找出最近改动频繁的区域，提出架构改进建议。
say.note: 它会用 git 历史定位热点。

howto.what_en: It scans your codebase, finds shallow modules and friction points, proposes deepening them, and produces an HTML report. You pick one; it then grills through the details with you.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze code architecture, find deepening opportunities, or focus on a specific module/subsystem/pain point. If nothing specified, it checks commit history to find hotspots.

say_en.text: Scan this project's architecture and suggest where to deepen.
say_en.note: It will generate an HTML report.

say_en.text: Focus on the user module — any shallow spots worth refactoring?
Find recently changed hot areas and propose architectural improvements.
